latest.title: Maintenance Window + Update 0.1.2
latest.summary: Minor update aimed at fixing XP & cash exploits, improving security, resolving WD-L020 crash error, and adding UI improvements to highlight Infantry Mode and Low-Level servers.

details: Fixed the issue caused by Windows 11 update KB5124010 that triggered WD-L020 crashes.
Revive action validity checks are now fully server authoritative.
Fixed vehicle fly-through exploit; rewards are now capped.
Rewards for destroying buildables now scale with build progress.
Depositing pallets into a FOB outside the zone now awards reduced rewards.
Players caught abusing XP/cash exploits or RMT have had progression reset and risk permanent bans.
New 'DEPLOY' UX flow highlighting Official, Community, Infantry Mode, and Low-Level servers.
Advanced Filters added back to Official servers.
Long server names no longer truncated; hover to view full name.
Join screen now shows connection status and queue position.
Anonymous mode hides server name on loading and pause screens.
Region select now shows number of selected regions.
Gamepad support added to DEPLOY selection screen.
Scheduled restarts: daily restart time (UTC) can now be set.
RCON AllowedHosts now restricts who can access RCON.
RCON message and broadcast lengths capped.
RCON defaults to Standard response detail.
ServerImageURL is now validated on config load.
Various server stability hotfixes.
Increased server security to prevent exploitation.
Throwables can no longer be used from enclosed vehicle seats.
Adaptive crosshair now hides correctly while aiming.
Buildable crit spots now behave consistently and remain reachable.
Fixed Havoc bug causing increased damage from 20mm and 30mm cannon fire.
Improved localisation translations.
Season 02 will include new map conditions, equipment, balance reworks, and additional features.
More information dropping next week.
